citations.quote: limit order traders give a valuable timing option to market order traders when they do not continuously update their limit order prices

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The equilibrium bid/ask spread compensates limit-order suppliers for the free timing option they grant market-order traders (a form of adverse selection) plus limit-order management costs, widening with volatility and slow cancellation.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Spread Anatomy: Limit-Order Timing Option and Adverse Selection
